Change c0147. Location: 1818 Vol. I, Ch. VI; 1831 Ch. VII.

Context before (unchanged): As I could not pass through the town, I was obliged to cross the lake in a boat to arrive at Plainpalais.

1818 text: During this short voyage I saw the lightnings playing on the summit of Mont Blânc in the most beautiful figures.

1831 text: During this short voyage I saw the lightnings playing on the summit of Mont Blanc in the most beautiful figures.

Diff: During this short voyage I saw the lightnings playing on the summit of Mont [-Blânc-] {+Blanc+} in the most beautiful figures.

Context after (unchanged): The storm appeared to approach rapidly; and, on landing, I ascended a low hill, that I might observe its progress.

result.rationale: Only the orthography of the mountain's name changes: 'Blânc' becomes 'Blanc', with the circumflex dropped. Wording, events and tone are untouched.
